= Transport of Diluted Species (tds)
:page-toclevels: 2
:description: Diffusion, convection and first-order reactions of a dilute species
:page-math: true

Diffusion, convection and first-order reactions of a dilute species. Elmer AdvectionDiffusion (streamline diffusion) or ModelPDE (Galerkin).

[cols="1,3"]
|===
|Category |Chemical Species Transport
|Name (tag) |`+tds+`
|Space dimensions |3D, 2D, 2D axisymmetric
|Studies |Stationary, Time Dependent
|Dependent variables |`+c+` Concentration (`+mol/m^3+`)
|Default features |<<tds-tp,Transport Properties>>, <<tds-init,Initial Values>>, <<tds-nf,No Flux>>
|===

latexmath:[\frac{\partial c}{\partial t} + \nabla\cdot(-D\nabla c) + \mathbf{u}\cdot\nabla c = R]

== Interface settings

[cols="3,1,1,2,3",options="header",stripes=even]
|===
|Setting |Symbol |Unit |Default |Choices / type
5+h|Discretization
|Element order | | |Quadratic |Linear, Quadratic
5+h|Dependent Variables
|Species (dependent variable name) +
_Each Transport of Diluted Species interface solves one species; a second interface needs its own name, e.g. c2, and streamline diffusion (AdvectionDiffusion keeps the species' keywords apart)_ | | |`+c+` |Text
5+h|Consistent Stabilization
|Streamline diffusion +
_Consistent stabilization of convection-dominated transport (element Péclet number > 1), which otherwise oscillates from node to node: streamline-upwind Petrov-Galerkin (SUPG). Consistent: it vanishes for the exact solution. Elmer AdvectionDiffusion; without it, Galerkin ModelPDE. A first-order rate constant (Reactions) needs the Galerkin form._ | | |On |Check box
5+h|Elmer Solver
|Additional Elmer solver keywords +
_Lines appended verbatim to this interface's Solver section in the .sif file_ | | | |Text (multi-line)
|===
